entries.title: Draft graph model: C3*C2 tree of triangles
entries.statement: DRAFT, independent review pending. The free product Gamma=C3*C2, with a of order 3 and s of order 2, has simple undirected Cayley graph for S={a,a inverse,s}. It is 3-regular. The a-cosets are triangles, every vertex has one s-bridge, and contracting triangles yields the 3-regular tree. For any finite nonempty vertex set K, |boundary_E K|>=|K|/3+2, so the graph is nonamenable. The proof uses free-product normal form and the forest count on occupied quotient blocks.
assumptions: Fixed simple Cayley graph of C3*C2 with generators a,a inverse,s

entries.title: REFUTED route: nonamenability universally supplies pc beta<1
entries.statement: REFUTED ROUTE PROPOSAL, NOT AN ACCEPTED THEOREM. For a d-regular nonamenable Cayley graph, let b=d-1, alpha=||A||_2 and beta=sqrt(b) if alpha<=2sqrt(b), otherwise beta=(alpha+sqrt(alpha squared-4b))/2. The proposed universal shortcut p_c beta<1 is false. Its use as an extra sufficient hypothesis in a conditional operator bound remains valid. The fixed C3*C2 tree-of-triangles graph instead has p_c beta>1.
assumptions: Fixed simple Cayley graph of C3*C2 with generators a,a inverse,s

entries.title: Draft author proof: obstruction to the universal nonbacktracking shortcut
entries.statement: UNREVIEWED AUTHOR PROOF, novelty not asserted. On the 3-regular Cayley graph of C3*C2 with S={a,a inverse,s}, Bernoulli bond percolation explores disjoint triangle blocks with nonroot offspring mean m(p)=2p(p+p squared-p cubed). At p=3/5 this mean is 558/625<1, so p_c>3/5. Constant-on-triangle test vectors give alpha=||A||_2>=2+2sqrt(2)/3. The nonbacktracking root beta=(alpha+sqrt(alpha squared-8))/2 is greater than 5/3, because z+2/z at z=5/3 is 43/15<2+2sqrt(2)/3. Hence p_c beta>1. A closed bridge separates independent surviving half-tree clusters with positive probability for p_c<p<1, yielding p_u=1. This refutes the extra universal spectral shortcut and is a special case of C0047, not a counterexample to it.
assumptions: Fixed simple Cayley graph of C3*C2 with generators a,a inverse,s
